title: shared learned beam codebook with sector Mirror View
hypothesis: One shared phase-only beam codebook plus compact sector Givens/phase Views will retain near-independent-sector spectral efficiency with materially fewer actual bytes and beat same-budget scalar and rank-2 phase-offset controls on held-out channel worlds.

mirror_insertion.physical_object: one learned phase-only 8-beam codebook for an 8-element ULA
mirror_insertion.coordinate: one sector-specific phase View added to each shared codeword across array elements
mirror_insertion.logical_functions: four sector-conditioned beam codebooks, addressed with 3-bit feedback among 8 beams
controls: shared codebook plus scalar sector phase
shared codebook plus rank-2 factorized phase correction

channel_simulation.array: 8-element half-wavelength uniform linear array, single RF chain, constant-modulus phase-only transmit beam
channel_simulation.channel: three-path narrowband Rayleigh channel; path angles Gaussian around sector center with 3-degree standard deviation; independent complex Gaussian path gains normalized by path count

training.objective: temperature-0.2 log-sum-exp approximation to expected maximum selected-beam spectral efficiency
training.initialization: shared DFT phase codebook plus zero sector corrections for all learned methods; independent method receives a copy per sector

metrics: beam selection accuracy versus continuous matched beam
actual serialized inference payload bytes including all sector views and metadata

storage.authority: actual torch.save inference payload byte length
paid_objects: all shared or independent codebook phases

gates.quality_storage: In all three fresh channel worlds, Mirror mean rate must be within 0.20 bit/s/Hz of independent-sector codebooks and use <=0.75x their actual payload bytes.
gates.mirror_specific: In all three fresh worlds, Mirror must beat the byte-near rank-2 phase correction by >=0.10 bit/s/Hz; when payload differs by >5%, report the comparison unmatched and fail this gate.
gates.failure: Mirror misses quality/storage in at least two fresh worlds or fails the rank-2 control margin in two or more worlds.
gates.audit: No external audit dataset; fresh channel worlds are the locked holdout.

boundaries: no real CSI, hardware, RF switching delay, energy, or multipath field measurement
